data.creator_notes:
Yep! There she is! Violet in all her glory... or not yet. I've been thinking about it for a while ever since I revisited my old Violet bot and realized she was *really* fucking fun to interact with, but my old writing kinda sucked and the greetings were all random. It still surprises me to know that she remained my most famous bot. I've been meaning to do something with her again for a while, now, like a remake, but I decided to take the opportunity to do something equally special as a thank you for the 200 followers: a prequel bot!

This is Violet, back in her old days when she was still just a dreamer chasing her dreams... and with problems of her own. I decided to add a little bit of "seriousness" to her backstory, and although I wouldn't consider it "Saviourfagging", I added the tag anyway because depending on how you play your cards, it can get really emotional as it did for me. Anyway, I hope you enjoy her as much as I did and, for those who care, keep your eyes peeled because I'll definitely give her sequel a remake one day! Once again, thanks for the 200!

1. Violet tries to use a pick-up line. She fumbles it in front of everyone.
